backend/main.mo: Defines the main backend actor with types and state for media, tutorials, posts, products, orders, users, tokens, AI interactions, branding, and more.
backend/token.mo: Implements a token system with balances, transaction histories, and operations such as minting, transferring, spending, and earning tokens.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata linking features to source files, components, and related test IDs for build verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries for a wide set of frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file that initializes the frontend by mounting the React app into the #root div and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, global providers, authentication checks, profile creation modal logic, and global AI chat integration.
frontend/src/components/AddProductDialog: Dialog form for creating products with image uploads, previews, validation, and media upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddTutorialDialo: Dialog for creating tutorials, handling video upload or selection, metadata fields, validation, and submission via backend hooks.
frontend/src/components/admin/BrandingSe: Admin panel for editing site branding, including site name, slogan, logo, and icon uploads with preview and progress.
frontend/src/components/admin/HeroSettin: Admin section for updating hero headline, subheadline, and hero image with upload handling and previews.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersSect: Displays a list of all orders for admins, including loading/empty states and formatted badges for status and payment type.
frontend/src/components/admin/PageSettin: Provides forms for editing page titles, subtitles, and banner images with upload support and saving via backend APIs.
frontend/src/components/admin/PaymentSet: Manages Stripe test/live secret keys and active mode, with validation, saving, and configuration display.
frontend/src/components/AIAssistantPanel: UI panel that periodically requests AI feedback for a tutorial based on video timestamp and displays feedback and suggestions with enable/disable controls.
frontend/src/components/AIChatTutor.tsx: Floating chat widget that manages user/AI messages, auto-scroll, authentication checks, and generates canned AI responses based on query keywords.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-out cart managing items, totals, token discounts, checkout flows (Stripe or tokens), and buyer info validation.
frontend/src/components/checkout/BuyerDe: Renders form fields for buyer name, phone, and notes with basic validation display.
frontend/src/components/checkout/StripeC: Handles Stripe checkout creation, buyer detail validation, token discounts, and redirects to Stripe.
frontend/src/components/DepositICPDialog: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditProductDialo: Dialog for editing product details, managing existing and new images, uploads, ordering, and validation.
frontend/src/components/ExternalBlobImag: Image component that loads an ExternalBlob URL with loading and error fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main site layout component handling navigation, branding, authentication, and favicon updates.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Simple full‑screen loading screen with animated music icon.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibraryMana: Admin/media tool for uploading, listing, and deleting video files with progress tracking and permissions.
frontend/src/components/MintTokensDialog: Dialog for admins to mint new tokens to a recipient with amount and description.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for new users to create a profile with username and bio before continuing.
frontend/src/components/RestoreProductsD: Admin dialog that restores predefined product templates by uploading asset images and creating products.
frontend/src/components/SendTokensDialog: Dialog for sending tokens to another user with validation against current balance.
frontend/src/components/ShareRecordingDi: Dialog for uploading an audio/video file, creating a media blob, and submitting a new community post.
frontend/src/components/StripeConfigDial: Admin dialog for viewing and updating legacy Stripe configuration including secret key and allowed countries.
frontend/src/components/WorkWithUsDialog: Form dialog allowing users to submit a name, email, and message as a work‑with‑us application.
frontend/src/config/appBuildInfo.ts: Provides helpers to read and format build/version metadata from environment variables.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, and identity loading. Wraps AuthClient creation and exposes login status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines many React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data using an actor, including user profiles, branding, media, access control, and more. Wraps react-query with actor availability checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and defines CSS variables for light and dark themes. Applies global background, text, and border styles.
frontend/src/lib/cartStore.ts: Implements a Zustand store for cart items with add, update, remove, clear, and item count functions. Stores product entries and quantities locally.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers. Loads global styles and renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks identity and admin access, showing settings tabs for branding, pages, media, products, orders, and payments. Uses several dialogs for creating and managing content.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Displays community posts with banner, actions, and dialogs for sharing recordings or applying to work. Fetches posts and page settings while gating share actions behind authentication.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays hero content, feature highlights, and previews of tutorials and products on the homepage using fetched settings and data.
frontend/src/pages/LearningPage.tsx: Shows a banner, difficulty filters, and a grid of tutorials with support for loading states and dynamic page settings.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Clears checkout state and presents a payment failure message with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Verifies Stripe session status, creates a purchase order, clears cart and context, updates queries, and displays a success message.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user’s profile, token balance, uploaded content, and purchased content with navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/StorePage.tsx: Lists store products with admin management tools, cart interactions, and auto-opening checkout behavior.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: React page showing the user's token wallet with balance, transaction history, and a send‑tokens dialog, handling loading and identity states.
frontend/src/types.ts: Shared TypeScript interfaces and enums for roles, tutorials, posts, settings, AI interactions, chat, and token transactions.
frontend/src/utils/stripeCheckoutContext: Utility to save, load, and clear Stripe checkout state in sessionStorage with 30‑minute expiry.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persisted parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and container settings with custom plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing Stripe checkout implementation requirements, existing features, issues, and pending requests.
